projects.title: PostgreSQL Adaptive Joins
projects.body: Co-author on a paper implementing OSL and ROSL adaptive join algorithms directly inside PostgreSQL's NestLoop executor in C. OSL ranks outer tuples by a multi-armed-bandit reward from N-Failure exploration; ROSL adds an unbiased estimator using Inverse Selection Probability Weighting so the query can report approximate aggregates mid-execution with valid confidence intervals. Within 8% of Ripple Join, significantly faster on large inputs. Targeting VLDB, SIGMOD, or AIDB.

projects.title: Agentic Job Application Pipeline
projects.body: A bash-orchestrated pipeline of headless Claude Code agents that extracts job descriptions with Playwright, tailors a one-page resume from a canonical CV through deterministic render and fact-verification gates, and fills application forms — always stopping before submission for human review. Includes quota-aware retry, session-resume logic, and multi-provider LLM routing through a local gateway (OmniRoute). Built on the open-source career-ops framework; I designed the workflow, validation gates, and failure handling, and operate it daily.

projects.title: Fo Assist — Android Voice Agent
projects.body: Built in one weekend for Wajo's GSD virtual hackathon. A plain-Java Android assistant sends voice and screenshot requests to Fo, Wajo's AI agent, through a stdlib-Python bridge on my k3s cluster that speaks Fo's MCP over OAuth (DCR + PKCE) and pushes replies back via self-hosted ntfy. Approvals are single-use so stale or duplicate taps are rejected, each phone signs in with its own Wajo account, and a busy-call auto-reply texts contacts while I'm on another call.

projects.title: Personal RAG Chatbot
projects.body: Full RAG pipeline running entirely on my homelab — no external APIs. Questions hit a FastAPI endpoint, ChromaDB retrieves matching context via nomic-embed-text embeddings, and Llama 3.1 8B (served by Ollama on the GTX 1060) answers in first person from structured personal documents. Runs as a container on k3s behind Cloudflare Tunnel, and powers the chat widget on this site.
